resume_workflow: Working → Review → Finalize → Validate → Convert to PDF → Optional Save to History; explicit Resume Plan approval required.
cover_letter_workflow: Working → Review → Finalize → Validate → Convert to PDF → Optional Save to History; source-supported Phase 9A generation.
pdf_conversion: Local LibreOffice conversion followed by pdfinfo and pdftotext validation.
history: Optional document_history.json entries created only after explicit save-to-history action; no automatic history on minor changes.
application_workflow: Phase 9A application records, duplicate-aware creation, JD snapshots, checklists, notes, follow-up, manual submission confirmation, and status history.
profile_integration: Profile inspection and Phase 7 plan/apply flow with explicit confirmation.
phase6_integration: Existing generator imported as frozen component; approval and validation enforced by UI adapter.
phase7_integration: Existing profile update planner and apply functions used; no duplicated update logic.
phase8_integration: Existing planner used for JD analysis and Resume Plan; no duplicated matching logic.
phase9a_integration: Existing application assistant used for records, cover letters, status, and reports.

visual_qa.notes: Browser QA used the clean-port live Streamlit instance; browser element-index overlays are tooling annotations, not application UI.
